We have three two-hour blocks available: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, and 1200-1400. The facilities shop, clinic, and protected-network section each need an approved block or operating control before the period begins. Let's hear from each section on their requirements so I can finalize the plan.

transcript.text: Col. Harper, I need to flag something that hasn't made it onto the coordination-board slide yet. I confirmed this morning that the east distribution panel must be taken offline for the generator load test from exactly 0800 to 1000 tomorrow. The electrical contractor's signed work sheet is in the facilities binder, but it wasn't added to the board slide. This means the facilities shop has a hard requirement on the 0800-1000 block.
